[SWS_PHM_00232]
{DRAFT}
Keep Global Supervision Status
kSTOPPED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kSTOPPED
, the
Elementary Supervision
Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kEXPIRED
and
the
GlobalSupervision
corresponds to Operating System, Execution Management
or State Management, then the
Platform Health Management
shall keep the
Global Supervision Status kSTOPPED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
